title.zh: 【Chainlink 推出 CustodySync 解决方案，连接机构托管与 DeFi 借贷】
title.en: 【Chainlink 推出 CustodySync 解决方案，连接机构托管与 DeFi 借贷】

current_state.zh: Chainlink launched CustodySync, letting qualified custodians such as Anchorage Digital Bank offer institutional clients access to DeFi lending markets while assets stay in custody, with Proof of Reserve-attested balances and unified price data for LTV calculation.
current_state.en: Chainlink launched CustodySync, letting qualified custodians such as Anchorage Digital Bank offer institutional clients access to DeFi lending markets while assets stay in custody, with Proof of Reserve-attested balances and unified price data for LTV calculation.
